_note: Phase 1 voice-stack configuration for the Vapi assistants. Values marked VERIFY are provisional until the Phase 0 bake-off (docs/phase-0/0.3-provider-bakeoff.md) picks the winners; Vapi's API validation is the final check (npm run vapi:sync -- --dry-run prints the payloads).

model._verify: VERIFY: provider/model ids accepted by Vapi; pick by latency in the bake-off

transcriber._verify: VERIFY: Urdu/Punjabi/Sindhi/Pashto support. Alternative: { "provider": "11labs", "model": "scribe_v2" }. No 'language' field = automatic language detection

phoneNumbers._note: Vapi phone-number IDs. 'pakistan' = BYO SIP trunk number (university UAN via the SBC); 'international' = Twilio number imported into Vapi.
